headline: Affordable coastal district with abundant schools but limited public transport connections

tags.reason: The affordability index is 83 compared to the Baku median of 50, with new flats averaging 1,450 AZN/m² against a city median of 2,295 AZN/m².
The education index reaches 71 against the Baku median of 49, supported by 5.57 schools per 10,000 residents compared to the 3.43 median.

summary: Xəzər is a low-density suburban rayon with 558 residents per km² compared to the Baku median of 2,890.5. Residential pricing remains below city benchmarks, with new flats averaging 1,450 AZN/m² and 93% of the 7,309 listings carrying a registered title extract (çıxarış). Day-to-day amenities are well supplied, including 28.46 grocery stores per 10,000 residents compared to the Baku median of 13.41. However, connectivity is constrained, reflected in a transport index of 19 and a distance of 18.5 km to the nearest metro station.
strengths: High housing affordability index compared to the capital average (affordability index 83; median 50)
Extensive retail grocery supply per capita (28.46 groceries per 10,000 residents; median 13.41)
Elevated density of primary and secondary educational facilities (5.57 schools per 10,000 residents; median 3.43)
weaknesses: Weak public transit connectivity scoring well below city levels (transport index 19; median 55.5)
Significant distance to the rapid transit network (nearest metro station 18.5 km; 0 metro stations)
Sparse public bus stop distribution across the territory (3.00 bus stops per 10,000 residents; median 6.22)
best_for: Buyers prioritising low square-metre costs with legal ownership documentation (93% title extract share across 7,309 listings)
Families requiring local schooling density without needing daily central metro access (5.57 schools per 10,000 residents)
watch_out: Commuting to central districts requires independent transit as the nearest metro station is 18.5 km away
Paved road coverage cannot be reliably assessed because 90.3% of the 2,361 km road network has an unknown surface type
confidence_note: OpenStreetMap coverage is high, but the land price of 15,000 AZN per sot is a mock demo figure from which no analytical conclusions should be drawn. In addition, 90.3% of the road surface network is unrecorded in the data.
